# Perform venmo friend updates to match phone friends
venmo_access_token = venmo_access_token
phone_set = phone_set
to_add = to_add
to_remove = to_remove

add_results=[]
for email in to_add:
    res = apis.venmo.add_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    add_results.append((email, res))
    print('add_friend', email, res)

remove_results=[]
for email in to_remove:
    res = apis.venmo.remove_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    remove_results.append((email, res))
    print('remove_friend', email, res)

print('add_count', len(add_results), 'remove_count', len(remove_results))

# Verification: fetch venmo friends after updates and compare to phone_set
venmo_access_token = venmo_access_token
page_limit=20
all_vfriends_after=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    results = page['friends'] if isinstance(page, dict) and 'friends' in page else page
    if not results:
        break
    all_vfriends_after.extend(results)
    i+=1

vfriend_emails_after=set([f.get('email') for f in all_vfriends_after if f.get('email')])
phone_set_ref=set(phone_set)

to_add_check = sorted(phone_set_ref - vfriend_emails_after)
to_remove_check = sorted(vfriend_emails_after - phone_set_ref)

print('phone_set_count', len(phone_set_ref))
print('venmo_after_count', len(vfriend_emails_after))
print('missing_from_venmo', len(to_add_check), to_add_check)
print('extra_in_venmo', len(to_remove_check), to_remove_check)
